result:
Done. Summary of the refactor:

- **`reportgen/config.py`** — added a frozen `@dataclass Config` with typed fields (`title: str = "Report"`, `output_format: str = "text"`, `max_rows: int = 10`, `include_summary: bool = True`). `load_config` now validates each JSON key against the dataclass fields (raising `ValueError: Unknown config key: <key>`) and returns `Config(**raw)`, so file values still override defaults.
- **`reportgen/formatter.py`** — all `config["..."]` reads switched to attribute access (`config.output_format`, `config.title`, `config.include_summary`).
- **`reportgen/loader.py`** — `config["max_rows"]` → `config.max_rows`.
- `main.py` and `__init__.py` needed no changes; `tests/` untouched.

`python3 -m pytest -q` → 4 passed. No commits made.
